title: Filesystem-backed session governance lock
context: Cloud-agent sessions can drift after interruption, so startup context must be enforced by repository artifacts.
decision: All sessions must follow AGENTS startup protocol and decision-status checks before implementation.
consequences: Session restart overhead increases slightly due to mandatory read order.
Governance drift risk is reduced by document-enforced handoff.
Policy exceptions require explicit user approval and decision-log update.
notes: If superseded, add a new decision record and reference this ID in supersedes.
